facts.text: Burlington is home to the Old Fashioned Apple Harvest Festival, the largest celebration of its kind in the Eastern Panhandle of West Virginia.
German and English settlers began populating Burlington in the early eighteenth century after the surveying of Patterson Creek Manor in 1738.
The Homestead in Burlington was originally built as a tavern to serve stagecoach traffic traveling along the old Northwestern Turnpike.
At least six skirmishes between Union and Confederate forces were fought in or near Burlington during the American Civil War.
Weaver's Antique Service Station in Burlington serves as a living museum featuring vintage gas pumps and classic car memorabilia.
The 1911 Twin Mountain and Potomac Railroad Station once hauled fruit from local orchards and now houses a public library branch.
